name: AutosavePolicy
summary: When the loaded slot writes itself: on each listed trigger, with `intervalSeconds` for the `interval` timer.

name: AutosaveTrigger
summary: What can make the loaded slot write itself (M5 spec §4.4).

name: Camera2d
summary: A presentation-only 2D camera over one container: it follows a target, shakes, and writes only that container's transform, never a sim value.

name: Camera2dOptions
summary: How `createCamera2d` frames the world: the view's size, and optionally a follow, bounds and zoom.

name: CameraRect
summary: A world-space rectangle, in logical px: `Camera2dOptions.bounds`.

name: Command
summary: Input to the sim (spec §4.4 rule 4).

name: CommandDef
summary: A command the sim accepts as input: an id and the Zod schema its payload must match.

name: ComponentDef
summary: A component: a stable id and a flat record of typed fields.

name: createCamera2d
summary: A camera writing `stage`'s transform (usually `PixiStage.world`).

name: defaultContent
summary: The default flow `title → play ⇄ paused → title`, with `paused ⇄ settings` (M4.4), and its hash.

name: defaultScreens
summary: The title, play, paused and settings screens (DX spec §7, M4.4) over the default content's flow (`title → play ⇄ paused → title`, `paused ⇄ settings`).

name: defineCommand
summary: Defines a command by id and payload schema.

name: defineComponent
summary: Defines a component from an id (lower-case words separated by dots or dashes) and its fields by name and type.

name: DefinedGame
summary: The runtime's `GameDefinition`, plus what the screens and the golden replay read from the spec.

name: defineEvent
summary: Defines an event by id and payload schema, to emit from a system with `ctx.emit`.

name: defineGame
summary: Checks a spec and fills in every default over the runtime, the Pixi renderer, Ruken hosting and the default screens; `startGame` boots the result.

name: definePlugin
summary: Defines a plugin from a name, its dependencies and its definitions, given in the keyed lists or in one flat `defs` list sorted by kind.

name: defineResource
summary: Defines a resource by id, schema and starting value.

name: defineSave
summary: Declares a save.

name: defineSystem
summary: A system: `defineSystem(name, run)` runs in `gameplay`, `defineSystem(name, phase, run)` in that phase, and the object form also takes `before`/`after`.

name: DrawContext
summary: What `draw` receives each frame.

name: DrawEntity
summary: One entity, read-only: its components' values are frozen copies.

name: DrawSim
summary: The sim at this frame, read-only.

name: DrawTextOptions
summary: Options for `DrawContext.text`: colour and font size.

name: EntityRef
summary: A live entity, addressed by its StableId.

name: EventDef
summary: An event a system emits: an id and the Zod schema its payload must match.

name: GameSaves
summary: What a game saves, and how the default screens read it from the sim and put it back (M5.2).

name: GameSpec
summary: A game in one object (DX spec §3.1): its id, size and sim, and optionally its title, input, views, sounds, scores, saves, content, screens, settings, extensions, draw layer and host and renderer options.

name: GameSpecError
summary: Every invalid field of a spec, by path: `size.width: …`.

name: InputMap
summary: Held keys, touch buttons and gamepad buttons, turned into one command per tick (DX spec §3.3).

name: InputSource
summary: The input map attached to a window for one play session.

name: KeyBindings
summary: By `KeyboardEvent.code`, so the keys sit in the same place on every keyboard layout.

name: keys
summary: An input map sending `command` once per tick with the payload of what is held: keys by `KeyboardEvent.code`, on-screen touch buttons, gamepad buttons, the stick and gestures, merged over the idle payload.

name: KeysOptions
summary: Options for `keys`: touch buttons, gamepad buttons, gestures and the stick, the idle payload, required keys and the Controls section's labels.

name: PluginDef
summary: A bundle of definitions the sim registers together: components, commands, events, resources and systems, the plugins it depends on, and optionally per-sim engine state and `config`.

name: postFilter
summary: Declares a screen-space filter over the whole picture: `renderer: { postFilters: [postFilter('vignette', { glsl, wgsl })] }`.

name: PostFilterDef
summary: A declared filter, as `postFilter` returns it and `PixiRendererOptions.postFilters` takes it.

name: PostFilterSpec
summary: What a screen-space filter is made of: the same effect written twice, for WebGL2 (`glsl`) and WebGPU (`wgsl`), so the two renderers stay at parity.

name: rect
summary: A filled rectangle that follows its component's `x`, `y` and `angle`, interpolated between ticks: `entityViews: { [Body.id]: rect({ w: 8, h: 8, color: 0xf9c22b }) }`.

name: RectViewOptions
summary: A `rect` view's size, colour and anchor.

name: ResourceDef
summary: A value the sim keeps once, not on any entity: an id, a Zod schema and the `init` that gives its starting value.

name: SaveDef
summary: A game's save: one record, or a fixed number of slots, each one Ruken key.

name: ScreensGame
summary: What the default screens need from the game.

name: Sim
summary: A running simulation, stepped with commands, that can snapshot, restore and hash its state.

name: SimContext
summary: What a system's `run` receives each tick (spec §4.1).

name: sprite
summary: A sprite that follows its component's `x`, `y` and `angle`, interpolated between ticks.

name: SpriteFrames
summary: The texture is a sheet of equal frames, read left to right, top to bottom.

name: SpriteViewOptions
summary: A `sprite` view's anchor and either its sprite-sheet frames or one frame of a packed atlas.

name: startGame
summary: Boots a game (DX spec §3.1): `defineGame`'s defaults over the runtime, the Pixi renderer, Ruken hosting and the default screens, then the runtime's boot on the game's root.

name: StepResult
summary: What one `step` produced: the new tick, the events emitted, the renderer's delta and the commands that were rejected.

name: SystemDef
summary: A system: a name, the phase it runs in, the systems it must run `before` or `after` within that phase, and its `run`, called once per tick.

name: TouchButton
summary: One on-screen touch button: every key bound to the same payload shares it.

name: AssetsSource
summary: What `content/assets.toml` says: for each screen, the files it waits for (`dir/*` names every file in a folder), and the atlases and fonts of the asset build it uses, by their names in `atlases.toml` and `fonts.toml`.

name: buildContent
summary: Compiles, writes every output under the output folder, then removes the outputs it no longer produces.

name: checkTuningLayer
summary: Checks one layer of tuning against code-owned declarations.

name: compileContent
summary: Compiles `<root>/content` in memory.

name: CompiledContent
summary: The result of a compile: the content and its hash, the sim partition, every output file's text, warnings, the languages and each language's message catalog.

name: ContentCompileFailed
summary: The authored content has problems.

name: ContentConfig
summary: The default export of `automata.content.ts`.

name: ContentData
summary: The compiled content as it is written to `content.json` and hashed.

name: ContentGenerator
summary: A generator: a unique name and a pure `generate` that turns compiled content into extra files.

name: contentHash
summary: 16 lowercase hex digits.

name: ContentOptions
summary: What the content compiler is given: the project root, the registered kinds, and optionally tunables, invariants, flow capabilities, generators, an output folder and Paraglide.

name: contentRef
summary: The ID of another content item of `kind`.

name: ContentSchemaDef
summary: A content kind a game registers: its name, the Zod schema each item must match, where its TOML files live, and whether the sim receives it.

name: ContentSchemaOptions
summary: Options for `defineContentSchema`; `sim: false` keeps the kind out of the sim's content and its hash.

name: ContentSchemaPlace
summary: Where a kind's files are: every TOML file under a folder (a collection), or one file (a document).

name: ContentWriteFailed
summary: An output could not be written.

name: DEFAULT_OUT_DIR
summary: Where outputs go when `outDir` is not set: `content/generated`, relative to the project root.

name: DEFAULT_PALETTE
summary: The palette a game gets when it has no `content/palette.toml`: Endesga 64.

name: defineContentGenerator
summary: Defines a generator by name and `generate` function.

name: defineContentSchema
summary: Registers a content kind: a name, its Zod schema, and a folder (every TOML file in it is an item) or one file (a single document).

name: Diagnostic
summary: One authoring problem: a stable `code`, the file to open, the 1-based line and column, the dotted key inside it and a message that says what to write instead.

name: DiagnosticCode
summary: Stable codes.

name: FlowCapabilities
summary: What the game's code implements: the screens, and optionally the pairs and destinations each allows.

name: FlowGraph
summary: The checked screen flow from `flow.toml`: the entry screen, every screen, the terminal screens and every transition, in a fixed order.

name: FlowTransition
summary: One checked move in the flow: on `event` the game goes `from` one screen `to` another, drawn in the `transition` style (`cut` when unwritten).

name: formatDiagnostic
summary: `content/tuning.toml:12:1 GRAVITY outOfRange: expected -1200..-100, received -2000`

name: GameSource
summary: What `content/game.toml` says about the game: its source language, rating, content descriptors, estimated hours, the analytics events it may send, and the screens whose files are preloaded.

name: GeneratorInput
summary: Everything a generator is given: the compiled content and its hash, the sim partition, the registered schemas, the message catalog and the tuning metadata.

name: GeneratorOutput
summary: What a generator returns: files to write and diagnostics to report.

name: InvalidContentConfig
summary: The game's code registered something unusable (a duplicate kind, a clashing generator).

name: localized
summary: Text a player reads, written in the source language.

name: MessageCatalog
summary: One locale's messages: message key to translated text.

name: messageKey
summary: The message key of one text.

name: MessageLocation
summary: A message's place in its file, 1-based.

name: Palette
summary: The game's palette: a name and its colors.

name: ParaglideOptions
summary: Where and which catalogs `ContentOptions.paraglide` compiles with Paraglide on build.

name: PreloadInput
summary: What `preloadList` reads: the content options (to compile `game.toml` and `assets.toml`, and to find the asset build's outputs below `outDir`) and the built game folder.

name: preloadList
summary: The files Ruken preloads before the game starts, in order, for `[loading] preload`: each `preload_screens` screen's files from `assets.toml` (the flow's entry when none is named), then the pages of the atlases and every language's subset of the fonts it names there, which `automata-content assets` wrote below `outDir` and the build serves in `atlases/` and `fonts/`; without repeats.

name: renderTuningTable
summary: Every tunable once, sorted by name, with its type, range and value in `content/tuning.toml`.

name: RukenFields
summary: The `[content]` and `[analytics]` tables of Ruken's manifest, worked out from `game.toml` and the languages present and written to `ruken-fields.json`.

name: SimPartition
summary: The part of the compiled content the sim receives (`tuning` and every kind with `sim: true`) and its hash, which gates snapshots and replays.

name: sortDiagnostics
summary: Returns the diagnostics in the one fixed order (file, line, column, key, code, message), without changing the input.

name: TunableDeclaration
summary: A tunable a game declares in code: `int` or `float`, an inclusive range and a default.

name: TunableDeclarations
summary: A game's tunables by name (upper-case words joined by underscores, such as `GRAVITY`).

name: TuningMeta
summary: Every tunable's type, value and range (`min`, `max`, `step`) by name, as written to `tuning-meta.json` for debug sliders.

name: verifyContent
summary: Fails with `staleArtifact` for each committed output that differs from a fresh compile.

name: withTuningTable
summary: The guide with its generated section replaced, or undefined when it has no markers.

name: ATLAS_EXTRUDE
summary: Pixels of each frame's edge repeated around it, so filtering never samples a neighbour.

name: ATLAS_PADDING
summary: Transparent pixels between cells, and between a cell and the page edge.

name: ATLAS_PAGE_MAX
summary: The largest atlas page side, in pixels: WebGL2's guaranteed `MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE`.

name: AtlasFrameTooLarge
summary: A frame that cannot fit a page even alone.

name: AtlasOutputs
summary: What `buildAtlases` produces; the caller writes it.

name: buildAtlases
summary: Builds every atlas `<root>/content/atlases.toml` names, or fails with every problem found.

name: buildFonts
summary: Builds every subset `<root>/content/fonts.toml` names, or fails with every problem found.

name: fontCoverage
summary: Whether a font file (TrueType, OpenType, woff or woff2) has a glyph for each character.

name: FontOutputs
summary: What `buildFonts` produces; the caller writes it.

name: FontsFile
summary: `content/fonts.toml`: each source font by name.

name: FontSource
summary: One source font: its committed file, the sha256 of its bytes, its licence and the languages it serves.

name: FrameSize
summary: A frame to pack: its name (the PNG's file name without `.png`) and size in pixels.

name: PackedAtlas
summary: Every frame's placement, and the pages they fill.

name: packFrames
summary: Packs `frames` into atlas pages.

name: Placement
summary: Where a frame's own pixels are: inside its extrusion, on page `page`.

name: subsetWoff2
summary: The font cut to `characters`, as woff2.

name: ALWAYS_CHARACTERS
summary: Printable ASCII, CJK symbols and punctuation, half- and full-width forms, and the symbols the UI draws.

name: catalogCharacters
summary: Every character the catalog's messages show.

name: ContentText
summary: `text(kind, id, path, authored, inputs?)`: the text in the active locale, or the authored text.

name: ContentTextOptions
summary: Options for `createContentText`.

name: createContentText
summary: A lookup over the messages module Paraglide compiles into `paraglide.outdir` (its `messages.js`, imported whole).

name: endonymOf
summary: A language's name in its own language ("日本語" for `ja`), from the browser's `Intl.DisplayNames`.

name: hasRawText
summary: True when a piece of visible text has English in it that did not come from the xx-long catalog: any ASCII letter outside a ⟦ ⟧ span.

name: localeCharacters
summary: A locale's own characters for its subset font: `ALWAYS_CHARACTERS` and the catalog's characters.

name: MessageCatalog
summary: One locale's messages: message key to translated text.

name: messageKey
summary: The message key of one text.

name: MessageValue
summary: A value in an inlang message file: a message, a list of variants, or a namespace or variant object.

name: PSEUDO_LOCALE
summary: The pseudo-locale's tag.

name: pseudoLocalize
summary: The xx-long form of one message string.

name: pseudoMessages
summary: The xx-long form of a whole message file (the inlang message format): nested namespaces are walked, plural variants keep their `declarations` and `selectors` (they are code, not text) and only their `match` texts change.

summary: `snow-shrine` → `snow_shrine`, `fastFall` → `fast_fall`, `melee/sword` → `melee_sword`.

summary: The Vite plugin that compiles content and serves it as `virtual:automata/content`.

summary: The import path of the compiled content: `content`, `contentHash`, `simContent` and `simContentHash`.

summary: Ruken's error codes (`@ruken/protocol` `ERROR_CODES`), as the SDK's `RukenError` carries them.

name: findRukenSdkMarkers
summary: The markers found in `code` (built JavaScript), each named once; empty means no Ruken SDK code.

name: HOST_EXIT_CAP
summary: How long the game may hold the host's close (FloorFifty `ruken/exit.ts`, Ruken P6 §4 "1 s cap").

name: HostError
summary: Any failure after the handshake.

name: HostHandshakeFailed
summary: The page is inside a frame, but the SDK got no usable welcome and fell back to its standalone session.

name: Hosting
summary: Everything a game may ask of, or hear from, its host: the `Hosting` contract of the M1 shared contracts spec §1, implemented by the host lane.

name: HostingLeaderboards
summary: The host's leaderboards (Ruken's `LeaderboardsApi`, PRODUCT spec §2 F1).

name: HostingLive
summary: The single `Hosting` layer for games (shared contracts §1.1).

name: HostingOptions
summary: What the game asks of its host.

name: HostingSaves
summary: The player's saves (shared contracts §1.1).

name: HostingSeams
summary: Test seams.

name: makeHosting
summary: Builds `Hosting` over `Ruken.init`.

name: RUKEN_SDK_MARKERS
summary: String literals only the Ruken SDK contains, which survive minification (PUB spec §3): the SDK's storage probe key (`env-browser.ts`) and its standalone refusal message (`standalone.ts`), at RukenApp d0fa2fe (as at b30d31b).

name: toHostError
summary: Turns whatever the SDK threw or rejected with into a `HostError`.

name: FakeHostClock
summary: The clock shape `@ruken/sdk-host`'s fake host takes; the game's `SdkEnv.timers` run on it too.

name: FakeHostHandle
summary: The fake host behind `HostingTest`, for tests that drive the host side.

name: HostingTest
summary: `HostingLive` wired to `@ruken/sdk-host`'s fake host over in-memory ports, with the real SDK in between (shared contracts §1.1).

name: HostingTestOptions
summary: What to change about `HostingTest`'s defaults: the game's hosting options, the fake host, the SDK environment and the game's origin.

name: manualClock
summary: SDK and fake-host timing (hello retries, the 10 s handshake give-up, request timeouts) runs on this clock, so a test can step past them without waiting (shared contracts §1.4).

name: ManualClock
summary: A clock that moves only when the test calls `advance`.

name: realClock
summary: Real time, for tests that only need the host to answer.

name: runScoped
summary: Runs a test program in a fresh scope, closing it (and every layer built inside) at the end.

name: TEST_GAME_ORIGIN
summary: The origin `HostingTest` serves the game from unless `gameOrigin` says otherwise.

name: FileError
summary: Reading, writing, listing or removing a file failed.

name: Files
summary: The service's tag.

name: FilesLive
summary: `Files` on `node:fs`: synchronous calls wrapped in `Effect.try`, so the first failure surfaces as a `FileError`.

name: FilesService
summary: The file operations build-time code needs, each as an Effect.

name: ProcessError
summary: A program could not be started (not found, not executable).

name: ProcessRunner
summary: The service's tag; see `Files` for why it is not a `Context.Tag` class.

name: ProcessRunnerLive
summary: `ProcessRunner` on `node:child_process`: the real programs, with the parent's environment plus `RunOptions.env`.

name: ProcessRunnerService
summary: Runs a program with arguments and no shell.

name: RunOptions
summary: How a program is started: its working folder, extra environment, stdin, and whether its output is also echoed.

name: RunResult
summary: What a finished program left: its exit code (128 when a signal killed it) and everything it wrote to stdout and stderr, decoded as UTF-8.

name: TaggedErrorClass
summary: The class `Data.TaggedError(tag)` returns, written out.

name: canvasResolutionFor
summary: Calculates device pixels per CSS pixel for the canvas.

name: CompositeTarget
summary: The fixed-resolution composite (M4 spec §4.11).

name: createCamera2d
summary: A camera writing `stage`'s transform (usually `PixiStage.world`).

name: createPixiRenderer
summary: The core 2D renderer (ADR 0002) as a runtime `RendererFactory`: a letterboxed Pixi app on the render target, entity views from each step's render delta, interpolated each frame.

name: createPostFilterSlot
summary: A post-filter slot writing its composed filters to `target`'s `filters`.

name: DEFAULT_BAR_COLOR
summary: The letterbox bars' default colour (FloorFifty's plum black).

name: DEFAULT_BAR_FRACTION
summary: How much of the playfield's height each letterbox bar crops in a landscape view, by default (5%).

name: DEFAULT_FIELD_COLOR
summary: The default colour behind the playfield, under the world.

name: EntityView
summary: What an entity view factory returns: the container drawn for one entity, updated with its current and previous component values and the interpolation alpha, and destroyed when the entity goes.

name: EntityViewFactory
summary: Builds the view for one entity, or `undefined` to draw nothing.

name: EntityViewResolver
summary: Which view an entity gets: one factory for every entity, or factories by component id (the first id, in the record's own key order, whose component the entity has wins).

name: FILTER_VERTEX
summary: The GLSL vertex stage every AF filter shares: it passes the texture coordinate and the pixel position (`vPixelCoord`) to the fragment stage.

name: filterPrograms
summary: Builds a filter's programs from its GLSL and WGSL fragment stages on the shared vertex stages, so WebGL2 stays at parity with WebGPU (AGENTS.md).

name: FilterProgramsResult
summary: A filter's WebGL2 and WebGPU programs, for a Pixi `Filter`'s `glProgram` and `gpuProgram`.

name: interpolatePose
summary: The pose between the previous tick (`alpha = 0`) and the current one (`alpha = 1`).

name: lerp
summary: Linear blend; `t = 1` returns `b` exactly, because `a + (b - a)` can round away from it.

name: lerpAngle
summary: Blends two angles (radians) along the shorter arc, so a body turning from just under π to just over -π swings through π instead of spinning the long way round through 0.

name: LetterboxFrame
summary: The containers a letterboxed scene is built from (backdrop, world, ui, mask and bars), laid out for a view size by `layout`.

name: LetterboxGeometry
summary: Where `LetterboxFrame.layout` put the playfield in the view, in screen px: its scale and rect, the gameplay and scenery areas, and whether the view is portrait.

name: LetterboxOptions
summary: A letterbox's logical playfield size and its bar and field colours (defaults `DEFAULT_BAR_FRACTION`, `DEFAULT_BAR_COLOR`, `DEFAULT_FIELD_COLOR`).

name: MAX_RESOLUTION
summary: The highest canvas resolution (device pixels per CSS pixel) the renderer uses, at the `high` quality tier.

name: meetsTier
summary: Whether `tier` is `min` or higher: a pass registered for `medium` runs at `medium` and `high`.

name: PixiRenderer
summary: The runtime's `GameRenderer`, built on PixiJS, with its stage.

name: PixiRendererOptions
summary: Options for `createPixiRenderer`; every field has a default.

name: PixiStage
summary: The Pixi scene the renderer draws, as a game's `setup` sees it: the app, the letterbox's layers, the entity views, the post-filter slot and the quality tier.

name: PixiStageHooks
summary: What a `setup` may return to hear every step, frame and reset (DX spec §3.4, DX.3 decision E-1).

name: PORTRAIT_FIELD_TOP
summary: The most room above the playfield in a portrait view, in screen px (the HUD's top margin, M1 render-pixi spec): the field sits this far down, or centred when centring leaves less room above it.

name: portraitFieldHeight
summary: The playfield's logical height in a portrait view: what fits below `PORTRAIT_FIELD_TOP` and above the `band` of on-screen controls at `scale`, and never less than `baseHeight`.

name: Pose
summary: Where an entity view draws: position in world pixels and rotation in radians (Pixi `rotation`).

name: poseComponent
summary: The component a view reads its pose from: the one it was registered under, or (for a bare function resolver, which has no id) the first component in row order with numeric `x` and `y`.

name: postFilter
summary: Declares a screen-space filter over the whole picture: `renderer: { postFilters: [postFilter('vignette', { glsl, wgsl })] }`.

name: PostFilterDef
summary: A declared filter, as `postFilter` returns it and `PixiRendererOptions.postFilters` takes it.

name: PostFilterOptions
summary: Options for `PostFilterSlot.set`.

name: PostFilterSlot
summary: The post-filter slot (PRODUCT spec §2 F1): each owner (an extension, quality tiers, the game) keeps its own filters under its id, and the slot writes all of them to the target, ordered by `order` (lower first), then by id.

name: PostFilterSpec
summary: What a screen-space filter is made of: the same effect written twice, for WebGL2 (`glsl`) and WebGPU (`wgsl`), so the two renderers stay at parity.

name: PostFilterTarget
summary: Where the composed filters go: `PixiStage` (its scene's `filters`), or any Pixi container.

name: QualityBuild
summary: What `rebuildOnQuality` keeps mounted.

name: rebuildOnQuality
summary: Keeps something built for the player's quality tier (M4 spec §4.11), rebuilding it when the tier changes.

name: rect
summary: A filled rectangle that follows its component's `x`, `y` and `angle`, interpolated between ticks: `entityViews: { [Body.id]: rect({ w: 8, h: 8, color: 0xf9c22b }) }`.

name: RectViewOptions
summary: A `rect` view's size, colour and anchor.

name: RenderDeltaConsumer
summary: Keeps one entity view per sim entity in the world container from each step's render delta, and interpolates them between ticks.

name: RendererPreference
summary: The renderer backend: `webgl` (WebGL2, the default) or `webgpu` (opt-in).

name: RESOLUTION_CAPS
summary: The canvas resolution each quality tier allows at most (M4 spec §4.11).

name: SHAKE_DECAY
summary: Trauma lost per second: a full shake (1) is gone in 2/3 s.

name: SHAKE_MAX_OFFSET
summary: The largest shake offset per axis, in logical px, at trauma 1.

name: sprite
summary: A sprite that follows its component's `x`, `y` and `angle`, interpolated between ticks.

name: SpriteFrames
summary: The texture is a sheet of equal frames, read left to right, top to bottom.

name: SpriteViewOptions
summary: A `sprite` view's anchor and either its sprite-sheet frames or one frame of a packed atlas.

name: ViewAnchor
summary: Where the view's own box sits on its position: 0 = left/top, 0.5 = centre, 1 = right/bottom.

name: WGSL_FILTER_HEADER
summary: The WGSL counterpart of `FILTER_VERTEX`: the filter uniforms and bindings and the vertex stage, which passes the pixel position to the fragment stage.

name: actionsForGesture
summary: Every action `gesture` drives in `profile` (M4.3); none when it is unbound.

name: actionsForKey
summary: Every action `code` (a `KeyboardEvent.code`) drives in `profile`; none when it is unbound.

name: actionsForPadButton
summary: Every action the standard-mapping pad button `index` drives in `profile`; none when it is unbound.

name: ActiveDevice
summary: The device of the last real input, and the button labels of the active pad (`generic` before any pad).

name: AppLoop
summary: The frame loop service: `run` steps a sim at its fixed tick rate from display frames, with the commands for each tick, and the renderer draws every frame.

name: applyDocumentLocale
summary: `<html lang dir>`: the browser picks glyph forms and line breaking from `lang`, and the layout direction from `dir`.

name: applyOverrides
summary: The game's profile with the player's overrides applied (M4 spec §6): an override for an unknown action, one that binds a reserved input, or one with a pad button out of range is dropped and named in `dropped` (sorted), and the defaults stand for it.

name: AssetLoadFailed
summary: An asset download failed with a non-OK HTTP status or network error (status 0).

name: Assets
summary: The asset loader service: `load` fetches a screen's assets and fonts with progress, failing `AssetLoadFailed` or `LoadStalled`; `get` returns a loaded file by path.

name: Audio
summary: The audio service (M5 spec §4.6): one-shot sounds and looping music on the audio buses, unlocked by the first gesture after `session.ready`; the game runs silent when no audio context can be built.

name: AUDIO_BUS_NAMES
summary: The core audio buses (PRODUCT spec §2 F1): `master` carries the other four; M5-D3 added `voice` (announcers, dialogue).

name: AUDIO_SETTINGS_DEFAULT
summary: Not muted, every bus at full.

name: AudioBuses
summary: The audio-bus seam (PRODUCT spec §2 F1).

name: AudioBusGains
summary: The player's gain per bus, 0 (silent) to 1 (full), as a game's settings store it.

name: audioBusGainsSchema
summary: Validates saved bus gains; a bus left out is at full gain.

name: AudioBusName
summary: One of `AUDIO_BUS_NAMES`.

name: AudioContextLike
summary: The part of `AudioContext` the graph uses.

name: AudioDecodeFailed
summary: The browser could not decode a sound's bytes (M5 spec §6): that sound is silent and nothing else stops.

name: AudioDecodeFailedFields
summary: The fields of `AudioDecodeFailed`.

name: audioLayer
summary: `makeAudio` with its defaults, reading `Hosting`, `Assets` and `PresentationBus` from the runtime.

name: AudioLive
summary: The Audio service with its defaults: the browser's `AudioContext`, `window`, `document` and `fetch`.

name: AudioOptions
summary: Options for the audio service; each has a browser default, replaced in tests.

name: AudioServices
summary: What the service reads from the runtime.

name: AudioSettings
summary: The player's audio choices (M5 spec §7, M5.4), as FloorFifty's `audio` settings: the mute, the mute while another window has focus, and a gain per bus.

name: audioSettingsSchema
summary: A missing field takes its default; a bad record reads as the defaults, as every settings field falls back.

name: AuthoritativeSnapshot
summary: One authoritative state: the authority sim's `snapshot()` bytes at `tick`, with its `hash()`.

name: AutosavePolicy
summary: When the loaded slot writes itself: on each listed trigger, with `intervalSeconds` for the `interval` timer.

name: AutosaveTrigger
summary: What can make the loaded slot write itself (M5 spec §4.4).

name: BindingOverride
summary: What the player changed about one action: its keys, its pad buttons, or both.

name: BoardEntry
summary: One row of a board, as Ruken gives it; `isMe` marks the player.

name: BoardQuery
summary: What `readBoard` asks for: Ruken's `get` options (`scope` `top` or `around-me`, `limit`).

name: BoardState
summary: The state of a board after the game's last submit to it.

name: BoardView
summary: A board read for a screen: its rows, or why there are none.

name: BootDefect
summary: An unexpected defect during boot.

name: BootError
summary: Every way boot can fail; each draws on the runtime's boot failure panel (shared contracts §4).

name: browserHaptics
summary: The browser's haptics: its pads, its `vibrate`, and whether its pointer is a finger.

name: CAMERA_SETTINGS_DEFAULT
summary: The camera choices a new player starts with: the default turn speed, not inverted.

name: CAMERA_TURN_SPEED
summary: The range of "Camera turn speed" in degrees per dragged pixel (M4 spec §16.3.6, M3 spec §4.2): 0.25° by default, so a 1,440 px sweep is one full turn.

name: CameraDragTracker
summary: Turns pointer samples into camera drags for one `DragSink`: one pointer at a time, its horizontal CSS px per move, from a touch or pen's primary contact or the mouse's secondary button.

name: CameraSettings
summary: The player's camera choices, `camera` in the core settings: how far a dragged pixel turns the camera, and whether the turn is inverted.

name: cameraSettingsSchema
summary: A missing, malformed or out-of-range field reads as its default, keeping the other; a record that is not an object reads as the defaults, as every settings field falls back.

name: Capture
summary: The input a capture caught: a key by its `KeyboardEvent.code`, or a standard-mapping pad button.

name: CompiledContentData
summary: The compiled JSON content read by the runtime (spec §3.3).

name: ContentHashMismatch
summary: Content hash does not match expected hash.

name: contentHashOf
summary: The content hash formula: hex64(xxhash64(utf8(canonicalJson(data)))).

name: CORE_SETTINGS
summary: The `settings` save, version 1: the player's bindings (`input`), graphics quality (`display`), audio (`audio`), vibration (`haptics`) and camera turn (`camera`).

name: CoreSettings
summary: The settings every game carries: input bindings, display, audio and vibration.

name: createHaptics
summary: The haptics service over these sources; it starts enabled.

name: createT
summary: `t` over a messages module (`import * as m from './paraglide/messages.js'`).

name: DEFAULT_QUALITY
summary: `high` until PRODUCT.7 has measured the phone profiles (M4-D6); no device auto-detection.

name: defineSave
summary: Declares a save.

name: DeviceStorage
summary: Where a settings field that belongs to one device is kept (M5 spec §4.5, M5-D4).

name: DisplayCopy
summary: The words of the display policy: the landscape gate, the rotate hint for each orientation and the rotate toast.

name: DisplaySettings
summary: The core display settings a game's settings carry as `display`: `{ display: displaySettingsSchema }`.

name: displaySettingsSchema
summary: The schema of `DisplaySettings`: an unknown or missing quality reads as `DEFAULT_QUALITY`.

name: DragPointer
summary: What drove a drag: a finger or pen (`touch`), or the mouse.

name: DragSink
summary: Where drags go (`Input.drag`): CSS px moved to the right since the previous move, negative to the left.

name: DragStart
summary: The parts of a `pointerdown` that decide whether it may drag.

name: EventScores
summary: A sim event's type (its `defineEvent` id) → the board it scores on and the score its payload gives.

name: EventSounds
summary: A sim event's type (its `defineEvent` id) → the asset path it plays, or the path with its bus and gain.

name: Flow
summary: The screen flow service: the current screen, `dispatch` to follow an event's transition from it, `openMenu` for the current screen's menu, and `settled` once no transition is pending.

name: FlowFailure
summary: Why entering a screen failed: an asset load, a stalled download, or the screen's own failure.

name: formatDateTime
summary: A moment as a date and a short time in the reader's convention, in the reader's zone unless `options.timeZone` names one (a test names UTC).

name: formatDuration
summary: A clock-style duration from milliseconds, whole seconds: `01:15`, or `1:02:05` once there are hours.

name: formatNumber
summary: A number in `locale`'s convention (Intl.NumberFormat with `options`).

name: formatPercent
summary: A whole percentage of a fraction: 0.5 → `50%` (`50 %` in French).

name: FrameInfo
summary: One display frame: the interpolation alpha between the last two ticks, the frame's length in ms, and whether time is paused.

name: GameDefinition
summary: Everything a game provides to the runtime to boot (spec §3.3).

name: GameOrientation
summary: The orientation a game plays in; the ship config writes the same value as `runtime.orientation`.

name: GameRenderer
summary: What the runtime asks of a renderer: apply each step's result, draw each frame, and reset for a new sim.

name: GESTURE_TUNING
summary: FloorFifty's gesture tuning, the defaults.

name: GestureName
summary: A touch gesture (M4.3 recognises the swipes, flick and tap; M4.12 the camera drag).

name: GestureSink
summary: Where gestures go: held while a finger steers, pulsed for a flick or a tap.

name: GestureTuning
summary: Content tuning, in CSS px and ms; FloorFifty's values are the defaults.

name: GlyphFamily
summary: Which labels a pad's buttons carry, read from its id.

name: HapticPulse
summary: One pulse: a pad's dual-rumble (milliseconds, each motor 0..1), and a phone's buzz in `navigator.vibrate`'s terms.

name: Haptics
summary: The haptics service: a pad's rumble or a phone's buzz, when the device can and the player's Vibration setting allows.

name: HapticsOptions
summary: Where the haptics service finds pads, the vibrate call and whether this is a touch screen; replaced in tests.

name: HapticsSettings
summary: The player's Vibration setting: whether `Haptics` pulses at all.

name: hapticsSettingsSchema
summary: On unless saved off; a bad record reads as on, as every settings field falls back.

name: Input
summary: The input service (M4 spec §4.2): held actions from keys, pads, touch buttons and gestures under the game's profile and the player's overrides, menu edges, the active device and pads, and rebinding.

name: INPUT_SETTINGS_DEFAULT
summary: Nothing changed: the game's profile as it ships.

name: InputBinding
summary: What drives one action: keys by `KeyboardEvent.code` (layout independent), pad buttons, an on-screen button.

name: InputContext
summary: Where an action is live: during play, in menus, or both.

name: InputContextNow
summary: What input drives now: `play` (the game's bindings) or `menu` (the menu actions).

name: InputDevice
summary: A kind of input device.

name: InputOptions
summary: What the input service listens to: the window, the game's profile, the bus, and optionally the settings and the host's input mode.

name: InputProfile
summary: A named set of bindings, one per game action (PRODUCT spec §2 F1).

name: InputProfileInput
summary: What `inputProfileSchema` accepts: every binding field may be left out.

name: inputProfileSchema
summary: Validates an input profile, filling left-out binding fields with "unbound".

name: InputSettings
summary: The player's input settings, kept in the game's settings as `input`: the profile, the per-action overrides and the touch mode.

name: inputSettingsSchema
summary: The `input` field of a game's settings schema: `{ input: inputSettingsSchema }`.

name: Leaderboards
summary: `Board` is the game's board ids (its ship config's `leaderboards` keys); `string` until a game narrows it.

name: liveDeviceStorage
summary: The game frame's own `localStorage` as a device, with `prefix:` before every key so two games on one origin do not meet.

name: Loaded
summary: A slot loaded for play.

name: LoadMeter
summary: Watches downloads: `guard` fails a wait with `LoadStalled` after `STALL_MS` without progress, and calls its `onSlow` after `SLOW_MS`.

name: LoadStalled
summary: A resource download had no progress reported for STALL_MS (30 s).

name: Locale
summary: The locale service (PRODUCT spec §4): the game's locales, the one text is drawn in now, the player's choice and the text direction.

name: LOCALE_SAVE_KEY
summary: The save key of the player's language choice; absent means Automatic (negotiated).

name: LocaleCandidates
summary: The candidates, best first; each is used only when the game has a matching locale.

name: LocaleDef
summary: The game's languages.

name: makeAudio
summary: Builds the Audio service, which is also the `AudioBuses` seam.

name: makeInput
summary: Builds the Input over `target` for the scope's life: closing the scope removes every listener.

name: makeLeaderboards
summary: Builds the leaderboards service over `Hosting`; each submit's state is published as `leaderboard.submitted`.

name: makeSaves
summary: Opens the game's save for boot, with its triggers and its exit flush, for as long as the scope is open.

name: matchLocale
summary: The game's locale for a requested tag: the same tag (ignoring case), else the first locale with the same primary language subtag.

name: MAX_FRAME_MS
summary: The Last Light clock.ts 0.1 s clamp: at most 6 steps at 60 Hz, the rest is dropped

name: MAX_TURN_UNITS_PER_STEP
summary: The most one step's `camera-turn` may carry either way: 45°.

name: MenuAction
summary: A fixed menu action: it drives menus and the pause screen, never the sim.

name: MessageFunction
summary: One compiled message: Paraglide passes its inputs as one object.

name: MusicOptions
summary: Options for `Audio.music`: where to begin and which region loops.

name: negotiateLocale
summary: The order is the player's saved choice, Ruken's session locale, the browser's languages, the default (PRODUCT spec §4 item 2, as decided 2026-10-16: a choice made in the game's own picker outranks the platform's, as in FloorFifty, where detection runs only "when the player has not chosen one").

name: NetworkPort
summary: The networking seam (PRODUCT spec §2 F1): remote commands in, authoritative snapshots out.

name: PadInfo
summary: A connected pad.

name: ParaglideRuntime
summary: The parts of a Paraglide-generated `runtime.js` the runtime uses.

name: PauseReason
summary: `input`: the active pad was unplugged during play (M4-D9); Resume on the pause screen clears it.

name: pluralCategory
summary: The CLDR plural (or, with 'ordinal', ordinal) category of a count: one, two, few, many, zero or other.

name: PresentationBus
summary: The presentation bus: typed facts the runtime publishes for screens, audio and tests to hear.

name: QUALITY_TIERS
summary: Graphics quality (M4 spec §4.11).

name: QualityTier
summary: A graphics quality tier: `high`, `medium` or `low`.

name: qualityTierSchema
summary: A tier; an unknown saved value reads as the default, as every settings field falls back.

name: REBIND_TIMEOUT_MS
summary: How long `capture` waits for a press (M4 spec §4.2, §6).

name: RebindCancelled
summary: The player pressed Escape or pad B while a capture waited: nothing changes.

name: RebindConflict
summary: Refused: the input would leave `with`, a required action, with nothing on that device (M4-D4).

name: RebindError
summary: Why a rebind was refused, with nothing changed.

name: rebindProfile
summary: Binds `capture` to `action` on `device` (M4 spec §4.5, M4-D4): it becomes the action's only input there and leaves every other action live in an overlapping context.

name: RebindReserved
summary: Refused: Escape, Tab, pad 8 or pad 16 (M4-D3), or a pad button the standard mapping does not have.

name: RebindTimedOut
summary: Nothing was pressed for `REBIND_TIMEOUT_MS`: nothing changes.

name: RebindUnknown
summary: Refused: the profile has no such action.

name: Renderer
summary: The game's renderer as a runtime service.

name: RendererFactory
summary: Builds the game's renderer on a render target in a scope, failing `RendererUnavailable` when it cannot start.

name: RendererUnavailable
summary: Neither WebGL2 nor WebGPU could be initialized.

name: RenderTarget
summary: Where a renderer draws: the host element, the layout geometry, the loaded assets and the presentation bus.

name: RESERVED_KEYS
summary: Keys never bindable in a game's profile: Escape (the one back path) and Tab (focus).

name: RESERVED_PAD_BUTTONS
summary: Never bindable in a game's profile (M4-D3): Ruken's SDK summons the host on pad 8 (View), 16 is Home, Escape is the one back path and Tab moves focus.

name: RotateHintMode
summary: How a game locked to one orientation says so (Owner amendment, 2026-10-18): a blocking cover, or a toast.

name: runGame
summary: Boots and runs the game in a runtime Scope (spec §4 Failure and Shutdown).

name: RuntimeFacts
summary: Every fact the runtime publishes on the presentation bus, by name.

name: RuntimeHandle
summary: Controls the running game: shutdown closes the runtime scope (spec §3.3, planning note 11).

name: RuntimeSeams
summary: Test seams injected into the runtime boot program (spec §3.3, planning note 10).

name: RuntimeServices
summary: The runtime services a screen's `enter` may use.

name: Save
summary: A game's save (M5 spec §4.3): its slots' states, load, write and remove, and the progress `touch` keeps for the autosave triggers to write.

name: SaveDef
summary: A game's save: one record, or a fixed number of slots, each one Ruken key.

name: SaveEnvelope
summary: What is stored: a self-describing envelope, one Ruken key per slot.

name: SaveFromNewerBuild
summary: A slot was saved by a newer build.

name: SaveFromNewerBuildFields
summary: The fields of `SaveFromNewerBuild`.

name: SaveMigration
summary: One migration step of a save: version `n` data in, version `n + 1` data out (`SaveDef.migrations`).

name: saveOf
summary: Returns the booted save when `def.key` matches.

name: SaveRefused
summary: A write AF refuses on its own: over a save from a newer build (M5 spec §4.3).

name: SaveRefusedFields
summary: The fields of `SaveRefused`.

name: Saves
summary: The booted game's save as a runtime service (M5 spec §4.3), as `Settings` is for settings: its key and the `Save`, both undefined for a game without saves.

name: saveService
summary: Opens a game's save slots: reads the slot list from the host, then loads, writes and removes slots.

name: SaveServiceOptions
summary: What the save service stamps on every write and checks on every load.

name: SaveUnreadable
summary: A slot's save cannot be read: a damaged envelope, a missing or throwing migration step, or data its schema refuses (M5 spec §6).

name: SaveUnreadableFields
summary: The fields of `SaveUnreadable`.

name: SaveWriteOptions
summary: Options for `Save.write`: the slot's label on the list, and a sim snapshot to keep with the data.

name: ScreenContext
summary: What a screen's `enter` is given: the layer to mount into, and the screen it came from.

name: ScreenDef
summary: One screen of the flow: its id, whether it pauses the sim, its kind and fonts, and `enter`, which mounts it in its scope (closing the scope leaves the screen).

name: selectPlural
summary: The form for a count.

name: Settings
summary: The booted game's settings as a runtime service: its key and store, both undefined for a game without settings.

name: SettingsDef
summary: A game's settings: the key it is saved under, its version, schema, defaults and migration steps, and which fields stay on one device.

name: SettingsStore
summary: A game's settings value: read it, subscribe to changes, and update it (each update is saved).

name: settingsStore
summary: Returns the booted settings store when def.key matches.

name: SlotMeta
summary: A slot's header, read without migrating it.

name: SlotState
summary: What a slot holds, as the slot list shows it (M5 spec §4.3, §6).

name: SLOW_MS
summary: After this long, in ms, a download still running is reported slow (the loader says so).

name: SoundOptions
summary: Options for `Audio.sound`: the bus (default `sfx`), a gain and a playback rate.

name: STALL_MS
summary: A download that makes no progress for this long, in ms, fails `LoadStalled`.

name: STANDARD_PAD_BUTTON_MAX
summary: The highest button index of the W3C Gamepad standard mapping (0 = bottom face button … 16 = home).

name: StickDirection
summary: A stick pushed past its dead zone in one direction (M4.2 reads them).

name: SwipeIndicator
summary: What a swipe indicator draws: the anchor, the thumb, and whether the thumb is steering.

name: SwipeTracker
summary: Turns pointer samples into held swipes, flicks and taps for a `GestureSink` (M4 spec §4.4); it reads no clock and touches no DOM.

name: textDirection
summary: Text direction from the locale's script: the explicit script subtag, else the likely one CLDR adds (`ar` → `Arab`).

name: Time
summary: The time service: whether the sim is paused, and why; each reason pauses until it is resumed.

name: TouchMode
summary: How touch drives play: the on-screen buttons, or swipes and flicks over the whole screen (M4 spec §4.4).

name: touchModesFor
summary: The touch modes a profile offers: `buttons` when an action binds `touch`, `swipe` when one binds a swipe, flick or tap.

name: TouchStickSink
summary: Where the overlay's move stick goes: a vector clamped to length 1, y positive down, as a pad's axes.

name: Translate
summary: The typed `t` verb: `t('hello', { name })`, checked against the game's compiled messages.

name: TURN_UNITS_PER_TURN
summary: Turn units in a full turn: the heading wraps here.

name: turnUnitsFromPixels
summary: `dxPx` dragged at `degPerPixel` as whole turn units: positive for a drag to the right (which way that turns the heading is the game's convention), negated when `invert`, clamped to ±`MAX_TURN_UNITS_PER_STEP`.

name: typedBus
summary: Cast a PresentationBus instance to a typed view with game-specific fact types.

name: defineExtension
summary: Returns its argument.

name: ExtensionDef
summary: One opt-in feature of a game (M1 shared contracts §2).

name: ExtensionError
summary: A bad extension list.

name: GameConfig
summary: The parts of Ruken's manifest an extension may read (`@ruken/manifest` `Manifest`, never copied).

name: ResolvedExtensions
summary: Everything the runtime and the build tools need from a game's extension list, in one fixed order.

name: resolveExtensions
summary: Checks the list and puts it in a fixed order.

name: RukenManifestContribution
summary: What an extension may add to ruken.toml in M1: preload files.

name: FakeAudioContext
summary: A recording stand-in for an `AudioContext`: what was started, stopped and automated, with a clock tests move by hand.

name: fakeAudioContext
summary: `decode` turns the bytes `decodeAudioData` receives into a buffer, or throws as the browser does for bytes that are not audio; by default the bytes are the alias's UTF-8 text.

name: fakeBuffer
summary: A decoded buffer that remembers the alias it came from, so `started` can name it.

name: fakeFetch
summary: Creates an in-memory fetch implementation for deterministic loading tests.

name: FakeFetchOptions
summary: Options for `fakeFetch`: the fetch that answers urls with no route.

name: FakeFetchResult
summary: The fake fetch, and the urls it was asked for and saw aborted.

name: FakeGainNode
summary: A gain node of `fakeAudioContext`, recording its value, its targets and its automation.

name: FakeRoute
summary: How `fakeFetch` answers one url: a status, the body in chunks, a content length or type, a hang or a network error.

name: ManualFrames
summary: A frame source a test drives: `advance` moves time on and runs the frame asked for, if any.

name: manualFrames
summary: A frame source that runs a frame only when a test advances it, starting at `startMs`.

name: nullRenderer
summary: A renderer that draws nothing and records each call in `log`, for runtime tests without a GPU.

name: NullRendererEntry
summary: One call `nullRenderer` recorded.

name: NullRendererOptions
summary: Options for `nullRenderer`: `fail` makes it fail `RendererUnavailable`.

name: RuntimeTest
summary: Test harness providing `RuntimeServices | FakeHostHandle` for screen and integration tests (spec §3.1, §8.1).

name: RuntimeTestOptions
summary: What `RuntimeTest` boots: the fake host, the screens, content, settings and save, and the frames, renderer, fetch and locale it uses.

name: BoardName
summary: A board a source file names, by its name and position (1-based, at the opening quote).

name: boardNamesIn
summary: The boards one source file names, in source order; `undefined` when it does not parse (its typecheck already fails, and a half-read tree could report a board that is not there).

name: BUILD_ID_PATTERN
summary: A build's ID on the dev host: the commit's UTC time to the minute, then its short sha, for example `202610111205-abcdef0` (FloorFifty `deploy/bin/build-tag`).

name: buildIdFor
summary: The build ID for a commit: its UTC time to the minute, a dash, then the first seven characters of its sha.

name: ButlerFailed
summary: butler exited non-zero.

name: checkManifest
summary: Checks `ruken.toml` text with Ruken's own parser, so AF accepts exactly what Ruken accepts.

name: checkVersion
summary: A release's version must be its tag's (FloorFifty `deploy/tools/ruken-pack.ts`): the build Ruken shows as 0.10.2 is the one tagged v0.10.2.

name: declaredBoardsIn

name: DeclaredInputs
summary: The `runtime.inputs` a `ship.config.ts` declares, with the position of its opening bracket.

name: declaredInputsIn
summary: The `runtime.inputs` a `ship.config.ts` declares, read from the source as written (`automata check` reads files, it does not run them).

name: declaredOrientationIn
summary: The `runtime.orientation` a `ship.config.ts` declares, read from the source as written (`automata check` reads files, it does not run them).

name: defineShipConfig
summary: Identity function that gives a game's `ship.config.ts` type checking and editor completion.

name: deployDev
summary: Sends a prepared build to the dev host and returns its build ID and the URL it is served at.

name: DeployDevInput
summary: What `deployDev` sends and where: a prepared build folder, the commit it came from, the dev host's ssh target and URL, and whether the build becomes the one `/` redirects to.

name: DeployFailed
summary: The dev host's deploy step (tar or ssh) failed; `output` is what it printed.

name: EntryMissing

name: EnvValue
summary: One variable read from a game's `.env*` files, whose value the bundle scan looks for in the build.

name: FileError

name: findExecutable
summary: The first `name` on `pathEnv` that is an executable file, or undefined.

name: findInputsProblems
summary: Each disagreement between `inputs` (a config's `runtime.inputs`) and what the `keys()` calls in a game's sources bind, in `inputsProblems`' words; empty when they agree or the game has no `keys()` call to compare.

name: findOrientationMismatches
summary: Every `defineGame` in a game's sources that plays in an orientation other than `declared` (its config's).

name: findRootAbsoluteReferences
summary: Every root-absolute reference to one of the build's own files in a built folder, walking it in name order.

name: findSecretsInBuild

name: findUndeclaredBoards
summary: Every board a game's sources name that `declared` (its ship config's `leaderboards` keys) lacks.

name: gameOrientationsIn
summary: The orientations the `defineGame` calls in one source file play in, in source order; `undefined` when the file does not parse (its typecheck already fails, and a half-read tree could name an orientation that is not there).

name: inputsProblems
summary: Each disagreement between `runtime.inputs` and the bindings, in action order; empty when they agree.

name: isBoardSource
